note: Hand-written items for the caption-gate decision: is this OCR'd on-screen text a transcription of the spoken dialogue (a burnt-in subtitle), or incidental text that happens to be in the picture? Labels are the author's. The headline metric (spread across equivalent phrasings) needs no labels.

equivalent: The text on screen is a subtitle transcribing what is being said.
This on-screen text is a caption of the spoken dialogue.
What appears on screen is a transcription of the speech in this shot.
The visible text repeats the words being spoken.
This is burnt-in dialogue subtitling, not incidental scene text.
negated: The text on screen is NOT a subtitle of the spoken dialogue.
This on-screen text is incidental scene text rather than a caption of the speech.

equivalent: 畫面上的文字是台詞字幕。
這段螢幕上的文字是把說話內容打出來的字幕。
畫面中出現的文字，內容就是這一鏡的對白。
看得到的文字重複了正在說的話。
這是燒進畫面的對白字幕，不是場景裡本來就有的字。
negated: 畫面上的文字不是台詞字幕。
這段文字是場景裡本來就存在的字，不是對白字幕。
